I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-random message. I said I'd noted that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats and that I won't take any action, since he said none was needed.

The seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat in that channel. I didn't mention the wrong number from his #central-team post, and I didn't read #central-team at all.
